title: Your results, explained
subtitle: Expanded carrier screening · Reported {date} · {centre}
fromPhoto: From your photo, not yet confirmed by your screening centre

summary.carrier: You are healthy. Your screening found you carry {count, plural, one {a change linked to # condition} other {changes linked to # conditions}}.
summary.carrierBody: Most people carry a few gene changes without knowing. Being a carrier mainly matters when planning children.
summary.carrierBodySimple: Most people carry some gene changes. It mainly matters for having children.
summary.affected: Your screening found a result a genetic counsellor will go through with you.
summary.affectedBody: Some findings mean more than carrying a gene change. A counsellor explains what they mean for you, in your language.
summary.none: Your screening found no changes in the conditions screened.
summary.noneBody: This lowers the chance a lot, but no test can rule out every change.
summary.screened: {count, plural, one {# condition screened} other {# conditions screened}}
summary.carriers: {count, plural, one {# carrier finding} other {# carrier findings}}

findings.title: Your findings
findings.everythingElseBody: No changes found. This lowers the chance a lot, but no test can rule out every change.

detail.carrierHeading: You carry one changed copy of the {gene} gene, which is linked to {condition}.
detail.carrierHeadingNoGene: Your screening found a change linked to {condition}.
detail.affectedHeading: Your screening found two changed copies linked to {condition}.
detail.affectedBody: A genetic counsellor will go through what this means for you, in your language.
detail.beadsLabel: Your two copies of this gene: one typical, one changed
detail.notDiagnosis: A carrier result is not a diagnosis
detail.sameGene: It matters for children only if a partner carries a change in the same gene. If you both agree, your couple view shows any shared results.

teachback.title: Check your understanding
teachback.q1: Does a carrier result mean you are ill?
teachback.q2: Does a carrier result matter for children if your partner carries a different condition?
teachback.q3: Who can explain what your results mean for your family?
teachback.e1: Carriers are healthy. Being a carrier mainly matters when planning children.
teachback.e2: A carrier result usually only matters if your partner carries a change in the same gene.
teachback.e3: A genetic counsellor can explain your results and what they mean for your family.

actions.couple: Check for shared results with my partner

flagged.title: A genetic counsellor will explain your result
flagged.body: Some results, such as uncertain or complex findings, need a specialist to explain them. GeneBridge doesn't show an explanation for them. A counsellor will go through everything with you, in your language.

missing.title: Add your screening result
missing.body: Connect the reference number from your screening centre, and GeneBridge will explain each finding in plain language.
